title: Define MVP requirements
requirements: Define actors, services, goals, boundaries and measurable MVP acceptance with the user; record unresolved questions
acceptance: Document reviewed by cloud lead; unresolved business choices explicitly resolved with user; status ACCEPTED only after review

validation.name: accepted architecture document
argv: from pathlib import Path; text=Path('docs/requirements.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'Status: ACCEPTED' in text and 'DRAFT PLACEHOLDER' not in text and len(text)>200
